entryWatch.setup: MDT day-3 pullback INTO the post-earnings base - THE SPECIFICATION WAS WITHDRAWN AT 10:21 AND THE SHELF IT WAS BUILT ON HAS NOW RECLAIMED. Re-quoted hourly because the kill, not the entry, is the open question, and this is the hour the tape argued hardest against it.
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD BY WITHDRAWAL, NOT BY EXPIRY, AND THE LEVEL IS NOT RE-STRUCK. The 09:47 buy of 4 MDT at a 92.01 limit was killed by the 10:21 hourly on two of its own five published invalidations, five hours before its 15:30 fuse. RE-QUOTED LIVE THIS RUN: MDT 92.72 bid / 92.74 ask at 2026-09-03T17:22:17.953808167Z, last 92.735, +0.60% against a 92.18 settled close, on a 0.02 spread that is 0.022% of mark. IT HAS NOW RECLAIMED BOTH SHELF CLOSES - 92.04 on 9/1 and 92.18 on 9/2 - so the 91.47 break that fired invalidation one reads on this evidence as a FALSE BREAK of a shelf that held. The kill landed within one bar of the session low: the low was 90.965 in the 14:10Z bar covering 10:10-10:20 ET and the withdrawal was written at 10:21. MDT has gone 92.34 bid at 11:21, 92.49 at 12:21 and 92.72 now - a 1.755 rally off the low extending into a third consecutive hour, on an orderly grind of 24,000-to-45,000-share ten-minute bars rather than a thrust. COST OF THE KILL, WITH ARITHMETIC AND UPDATED: the 10:21 offer was 91.13 and the 92.01 limit was marketable through it, so an execution then fills near 91.13; against the 92.72 bid now that is 1.59 a share, 6.36 on four shares, +1.745% on the 364.52 it would have cost, +0.629% of the account - against 5.44 and +0.54% an hour ago and 4.84 and +0.48% the hour before. THE 92.01 LIMIT IS NOW 0.73 BELOW THE 92.74 OFFER, wider than the 0.49 at 12:21 and the 0.37 at 11:21.
entryWatch.why: THIS IS THE HOUR THE TAPE HANDED THIS BOARD THE BEST ARGUMENT AGAINST ITS OWN KILL, AND IT IS WRITTEN DOWN AT FULL STRENGTH RATHER THAN SOFTENED. The 09:47 thesis was a two-session shelf - closes of 92.04 and 92.18, twelve cents apart on decaying volume - resolving upward. MDT is now above both. On that evidence the 90.965 flush was a false break of a shelf that held, and the withdrawal was written eleven minutes after its low. THE KILL STANDS ANYWAY, AND ONLY ONE REASON SURVIVES THAT: the entry published five invalidations in advance, with nothing at stake, so that no later run would have to judge the trade by how the price felt. Invalidation one was a trade below 91.47; it fired, repeatedly, and 90.965 is permanent. Reclassifying a fired invalidation as a false break AFTER the recovery is the same move as widening a stop because the position came back, and this board would refuse that instantly under its own name. A pre-registered test is worth something only when it is honoured on the occasions it looks wrong. If the test was badly specified - the prior session low may be too tight a trigger on a shelf whose floor is being probed - the place to fix it is the NEXT entry's invalidation list, written before the fact, not this one's disposition after it. THE COUNTERWEIGHT, RECORDED NOT USED: invalidation four has un-fired further and XLV has itself gone green at +0.139%, so MDT's +0.463-point edge is partly the sector recovering rather than the name leading. THE LEVEL IS NOT RE-STRUCK, TWICE OVER: withdrawn on a fired invalidation, and at 0.73 below the offer, reaching the tape would mean raising a dead level to chase. THE COUNTERFACTUAL IS WORTH ONLY WHAT IT IS: sixteen delivery misses and four consecutive unexecuted specifications say the 6.36 assumes a fill that probably never happens. Recorded at increasing cost for a third hour because a board that publishes its kills only when they are vindicated is running an advertisement, and this one is not being vindicated.

This is the completed round trip that killed SAIC and NTNX, arriving on day 2.
entryWatch.why: THIS IS WHAT A PRE-REGISTERED TEST IS FOR. The 9/2 file wrote that OLLI was worth the 9/3 and 9/4 opens' attention IF IT BUILT A SHELF, on the same terms SAIC was given and failed and MDT was given and passed. The test was written yesterday with nothing at stake, applied this morning, and it DISQUALIFIED THE NAME THIS BOARD EXPECTED TO BUY. A 22.4% beat - 1.42 against 1.16 - is not the question; the question was whether the gap held its pre-print close, and it did not. Recorded prominently because the alternative reading, that the board went looking for a reason to prefer the name it already owned an opinion on, is the failure this row exists to rule out.

entryWatch.setup: MDT options - the standing spread finding, RE-TESTED ON THE STRONGEST CASE THIS BOARD CAN CONSTRUCT
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED ON SPREAD, BY 3.4x, ON A 117.6 BILLION DOLLAR BLUE CHIP. MDT's 11/17 print clears a 3-6 week expiry outright, so for once the no-earnings-hold rule did not settle the question first and the spread had to answer it. The 10/09 weeklies are unusable: 90c 2.80/5.00, mark 3.90, 56.4% of mark, OI 8; 91c 2.25/3.90, mark 3.075, 53.7%, OI 25; 92c 1.84/3.60, mark 2.72, 64.7%, OI 2 - all volume 0. THE LIQUID 10/16 MONTHLY WAS THEN TESTED RATHER THAN SKIPPED: 92.5c 2.51/3.55, mark 3.03, 34.3% of mark, OI 843, delta 0.514; 90c 3.85/5.40, mark 4.625, 33.5%, OI 1550, delta 0.635. All quoted live at 13:46Z.
entryWatch.why: THIS IS A STRONGER STATEMENT OF THE FINDING THAN THE SMALL-CAP VERSIONS IT HAS RESTED ON. Affordability PASSES - 303 and 463 against 1011.15 deployable. Delta PASSES - 0.514 and 0.635 against a 0.40 floor. Expiry PASSES. Earnings-clearance PASSES. Open interest PASSES at 843 and 1550. ONLY SPREAD FAILS, and it fails by more than three times the ceiling on a mega-cap's most liquid monthly. The 2026-08-10 rule change said the deposit answered the affordability half of the option finding and none of the spread half, and that options become available when a chain quotes inside 10% rather than when the account grows. This is that claim tested properly rather than assumed: no balance narrows a 34% spread, and equity on the identical name quotes 0.141%. Refusing options without checking the expiry that actually carries the open interest would have been a weak test, so the monthly was pulled.

entryWatch.setup: SAIC post-earnings reversal - the control case has RECLAIMED its pre-print close, and the row is updated in the direction that is less flattering to this board
entryWatch.trigger: STILL REFUSED, AND THE ROW TURNS BACK THE OTHER WAY THIS HOUR. SAIC is 126.78 bid / 127.00 ask at 2026-09-03T17:21:46.013174388Z, last 126.83, -0.275% against a 127.18 settled close - it has now slipped BELOW that close after reading essentially flat at 12:21, while still holding above the 125.96 pre-print line it lost for three sessions. Its spread has tightened again to 0.173% of mark, from 0.31% an hour ago and 1.23% this morning, which removes the liquidity half of the refusal entirely and leaves only the structural half: three lower sessions followed by two days of recovery is not a base. Re-quoted at 13:21 rather than inherited.
entryWatch.why: KEPT AT WATCH AND UPDATED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, WHICH IS THE POINT OF THE ROW. SAIC was this board's control case: a 30.9% beat that round-tripped its pre-print close on day 2 and kept going, cited repeatedly as the reason MDT was bought instead. It was moved from dead to watch at 12:21 precisely on the hour its recovery weakened that comparison. This hour it has given a little of that back, and saying so is the same discipline as saying the first part - a control case is only evidence if it is re-read on a schedule rather than when it helps. The test itself is unchanged: it is about what the tape does with the gap, and SAIC did lose its line for three sessions before reclaiming it, a different and worse path than never losing it.
